import sys
sys.setrecursionlimit(1000000)
MOD = 10**9 + 7

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    N = int(next(it))
    P = [[0]*N for _ in range(N)]
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(N):
            P[i][j] = int(next(it))

    iv100 = pow(100, MOD-2, MOD)

    id_map = {}
    trans = [None]  # index 0 unused
    # bitset represented as int (bit 0 corresponds to position 0)
    def dfs(x):
        if x in id_map:
            return id_map[x]
        cur_id = len(trans)
        id_map[x] = cur_id
        trans.append([0] * (1 << N))  # placeholder
        # compute tmp[0..N-1] bitsets
        tmp = [0] * N
        for i in range(N):
            for j in range(1 << N):
                if (x >> j) & 1:
                    tmp[i] |= 1 << (j | (1 << i))
        # compute transitions for all masks
        for mask in range(1 << N):
            tp = x
            for j in range(N):
                if (mask >> j) & 1:
                    tp |= tmp[j]
            trans[cur_id][mask] = dfs(tp)
        return cur_id

    initial = 1  # only bit 0 set
    dfs(initial)
    cnt = len(trans) - 1

    dp_prev = [0] * (cnt + 1)
    dp_prev[1] = 1  # id of initial state is 1

    for i in range(N):
        # compute prob for all masks
        prob = [0] * (1 << N)
        for mask in range(1 << N):
            p = 1
            for k in range(N):
                if (mask >> k) & 1:
                    p = p * P[i][k] % MOD
                else:
                    p = p * (100 - P[i][k]) % MOD
                p = p * iv100 % MOD
            prob[mask] = p

        dp_cur = [0] * (cnt + 1)
        for j in range(1, cnt + 1):
            if dp_prev[j] == 0:
                continue
            for k in range(1 << N):
                nxt = trans[j][k]
                dp_cur[nxt] = (dp_cur[nxt] + dp_prev[j] * prob[k]) % MOD
        dp_prev = dp_cur

    final_bitset = (1 << (1 << N)) - 1  # all bits 0..2^N-1 set
    print(dp_prev[id_map[final_bitset]])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
